$comment: Pinned upstream sources reviewed for QuickSheet. Checked weekly by the 'SRD Drift Check' workflow (tools/check-srd-drift.mjs), which compares fingerprints of currentUrl against sha256. Refresh pins only after a human review of the upstream diff (see docs/data-provenance.md). mode: 'sha256' = raw bytes; 'pdf-links' = sorted set of linked PDF URLs (a changed download pointer counts as drift); 'text' = normalized visible page text.
reviewNote: V1 review (2026-10-09). Old Gus pins unchanged. Publisher pages were reachable with a browser-like User-Agent (the M0 403s came from curl's default agent). Official SRD 2.0 and DPCGL 2.0 PDFs downloaded, hashed and pinned. All 135 imported Level 1 texts were compared with the official SRD: 127 match word-for-word, 4 differ only by PDF extraction artifacts or quotation marks, and 4 real Old Gus differences are corrected via officialOverrides in tools/curation/core.json (RD-025). All class Evasion/HP, card recall costs, weapon and armor statistics match. V2 review (2026-10-10): Old Gus and official pins unchanged. All 189 domain cards, subclass Specialization/Mastery features, Beastforms and all weapon/armor rows cross-checked against the official SRD 2.0 PDF; 10 Core-Rulebook-only weapons excluded and further Old Gus differences corrected (RD-025, RD-035). Drift review (2026-10-14): Old Gus advanced to 75428a9 ("add fear me colossus"); re-import produced no data changes beyond provenance commit/sha256 fields, so pins refreshed. Official SRD and DPCGL pins unchanged.
